name: Teen Sketch and Teen Podcast, Philadelphia Museum of Art
what_you_do: Join the Teen Sketch art program at the museum. Or work with other teens on the museum's Teen Podcast as a writer, researcher, host or producer.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page describes Teen Podcast as a program for Philly teens. The page does not list ages or a school-district rule for Teen Sketch.
pay_detail: Pay or stipend not stated on the page.
duration: Fall 2026 programs. Teen Sketch length is not stated.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs are listed with Apply links. No closing date is posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Each program has its own Apply now link (a Google form) on the teens page. Questions: teens@philamuseum.org.
notes: The page does not say whether the programs are paid or free, or when the forms close. Email the teen team before you plan around it. The museum also ran A Future of Artists, a June to August 2026 exhibition of work by Philadelphia-area high school students.
